title: Shark in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shark body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='34' ry='20' fill='#3f7fb5'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='26' ry='11' fill='#bfe3f5'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M42 36 L52 20 L60 38 Z' fill='#2f6a9a'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M82 50 L96 38 L92 56 L98 70 Z' fill='#2f6a9a'/>
  <!-- side fin -->
  <path d='M40 62 L30 78 L48 70 Z' fill='#2f6a9a'/>
  <!-- snout shading -->
  <path d='M16 55 Q18 43 32 42 L32 68 Q18 67 16 55 Z' fill='#2f6a9a'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='5' fill='#eaf6ff'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='50' r='2.6' fill='#123a5c'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M20 60 Q26 66 34 63' stroke='#eaf6ff' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- gill lines -->
  <path d='M42 47 Q40 52 42 57' stroke='#2f6a9a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M47 46 Q45 52 47 58' stroke='#2f6a9a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf band -->
  <path d='M38 42 Q48 50 62 44 L64 50 Q48 57 37 48 Z' fill='#e8543f'/>
  <!-- scarf knot -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='5' fill='#ff7059'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M64 51 L74 66 L67 67 L62 56 Z' fill='#ff7059'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d='M42 44 L44 50' stroke='#ffd66b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 46 L51 52' stroke='#ffd66b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 55 L70 62' stroke='#ffd66b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
